source.title: Newry Telegraph, 5 October 1946, p. 6 ("Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council: no contests")
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Unopposed returns from the Newry Telegraph (5 October 1946, p. 6), checked against the Newry Reporter's nomination report (21 September 1946, p. 1).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. There were no contests: every nominated candidate was returned unopposed, and the retiring members for Drumgath and Mayo were declared re-elected where no nomination was received. Three members were afterwards co-opted. Three members were co-opted after the election; their names were not printed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Newry Telegraph, 5 October 1946, p. 6 (council-audit, Nov 2026): Edward J. Brady -> Edward T. Brady as printed ('DONAGHMORE - Mr. Edward T. Brady, journalist, Ardarragh'), the initials the 1964 return also prints.
